facts.function: covers for an electric motor controller
facts.end_use: part of motor controller apparatus (heading 8537 assumed)

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8538 covers parts suitable solely or principally for apparatus of headings 8535, 8536, 8537
Section XVI note 2(b): parts of a particular kind of machine go with it or in heading 8538; section XVI note 1(g) excludes only plastic goods similar to general-use parts, not dedicated covers

rejected_alternatives.reason: other plastic articles; dedicated parts of electrical apparatus go to heading 8538 under section XVI note 2(b)
applies only if the controller is a speed drive controller (8504.40), not stated
other parts; covers are assumed molded

missing_facts: Type of controller (switchgear 8537 vs speed drive 8504)
classification.rationale: Plastic covers dedicated to an electrical motor controller are parts of the apparatus; heading 8538 covers parts of 8537 apparatus and the subheading for molded parts fits plastic covers. No close ruling was found.
